class.name: IfcMeasureWithUnit
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-41:1992 : A measure with unit is the specification of a physical quantity as defined in ISO 31 (clause 2). IfcMeasureWithUnit has two usages: 1. For representing measure value together with its unit on the entity type attribute level; thus overriding the IFC model global unit assignments. 2. For conversion based unit to give the conversion rate and its base. NOTE Corre

members.member: The value of the physical quantity when expressed in the specified units.
The unit in which the physical quantity is expressed.
